content.short: OpenCover protects portfolios against onchain risks by partnering with leading underwriters for users and institutions.
content.description: OpenCover partners with top underwriters to deliver protection against onchain risks, including smart contract exploits, scams, and governance attacks, for both individuals and institutions. The service suite includes portfolio cover and institutional services. As a leading source of onchain insurance and cover data, OpenCover allows users to purchase protection through its dApp, providing an onchain safety net. Coverage is available on leading L2 networks.
